case_name: Vishal S/O. Rajesaheb Gore vs Sow. Aparna W/O. Vishal Gore

parties.respondent_defendant: Sow.Aparna W/o Vishal Gore and Miss. Neha d/o Vishal Gore (wife and minor daughter)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The respondent had filed two different proceedings against the applicant; one under Section 125 of Code of Criminal Procedure and another under Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005.

legal_principles.principle: The monetary relief granted under this section shall be adequate, fair and reasonable and consistent with the standard of living to which the aggrieved person is accustomed.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act — Section 20

legal_principles.principle: The Magistrate shall take into account and consider, if any similar relief is already obtained by the aggrieved person.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act — Section 26

outcome.final_order: The interim monthly maintenance directed to be paid under Section 23 read with Section 20(1)(d) of The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 can be adjusted against the amount of maintenance awarded under Section 125 of The Code of Criminal Procedure.
